title: 第2113章 十四境剑修之能睥睨天下第2112章 剑如金丝无法托举的神木古鼎
content_zh:
人间十四境大剑修，只存在于传说的强者，竟然无法托举一方神木古鼎，神木古鼎砸向地面时，地面并没有崩坏，反倒是将被妖族战斗毁坏的大地以肉眼可见的速度修复，甚至就连被顾余生踩塌的诸座天柱峰都神奇地修复恢复原状。
神木古鼎被九根天柱峰顶着，稳当当地停在高空位置，周围流转着神圣的气息，苍翠的流光之中，有紫薇之气从太乙大世界汇聚而来。
传说中的人族气运加持，真的存在。
万妖城内的妖族无法侵近神鼎分毫，只能骇然避退。
左无剑以剑丝悬挂在一座天柱峰上，轻轻一荡，再一次出现在神木古鼎上方，五根金色剑丝重新汇聚于五指，幻化出八道分身，九尊剑影立于天柱峰上，手指一抬，同时结成剑阵，一朵巨大的青莲自大地而起，竟将整座万妖城完全包裹进去，九朵青色剑莲层层旋转，叠加交错，形成一朵巨大的青莲，盖过九座尖峰。
“九莲剑诀！”
顾余生看着那一朵朵比山岳还要大的剑莲，双瞳之中绽放出前所未有的精芒，这门剑诀，属于白玉京剑修人人可修的剑术，曾经他也见过数人施展，在他眼里，这门剑术本属于青莲剑诀的衍生剑诀，完全比不上青莲剑诀的玄妙，可是，当一位人间十四境的剑修施展出来时，这门剑诀的精妙，已经完全超出了他的认知。
每一朵剑莲的凝聚，都蕴藏着无上剑道，包罗万象，不仅万妖城被笼罩，整个大荒，甚至整个玄界的剑，都被剑莲牵引，九朵剑莲叠旋为一体，如同一座精妙的剑阙仙楼拔地而起，其技之精，令人叹为观止。
剑莲上的流光灵泽，将剑之意转化为实，左无剑凌站于青莲之上，随着青莲绽放，里面绽放出十八颗莲子，莲子从莲蓬里剥离，一颗一颗进入他的本体。
伴随着奇特的莲音，无法参悟其剑意的顾余生，却看懂了那剑莲之子正以奇特的方式打通左无剑身体内的隐穴，迅速开辟出一条经脉，这一条经脉，竟与他近日开辟出来的穴窍经脉有七八处相似。
轰！
伴随着一道强大的炁源冲击，左无剑的躯体呈现青色的光晕，所有的剑意被他敛入体内，巨大的青莲托举着神木古鼎，向上方飞升。
“起！”
左无剑出现在神木古鼎下方，以双手托举神鼎，衣衫爆裂开来，露出其健壮的肉身，只不过他的肉身，并不是传统意义上的武道修行凝成，而是以剑道融入肉身后形成的剑体术。
八道分身与本体一般无二，九影同时举手托鼎，青莲旋转，发出呜呜呜的颤音。
“呃……啊！”
左无剑的声音在天地间回响，强大的爆发力自他躯体传递到掌间，试图以身举鼎。
咔嚓！
一道闪电撕裂苍穹，仿佛要将世界一分为二，刚刚晴朗的天空乌云密布，宛若末日之景，大荒世界地动山摇，天地气息混乱，无数妖兽嘶吼怪叫，狂乱奔吼。
天空的数十艘灵船结界大开依旧无用，被未知的能量干扰，向大地坠落。

甚至就连顾余生这样的剑道修行者，也无法停留天空，如风吹落叶飘在地面，双脚踩在大地，好似地龙翻身，无法站稳。
咔嚓。
密密的闪电撕破苍穹，星空深处的世界留影闪烁，顾余生拥有的古鼎也随之呼应，隐约间，顾余生感觉到有几道神秘的气机与古鼎相连，它们分散于太乙各方世界，隐隐约约。
content_en:
The Fourteenth Realm Great Sword Cultivator in the world, a strong man who only exists in legends, was actually unable to lift an ancient sacred wooden cauldron. When the sacred wooden ancient cauldron hit the ground, the ground did not collapse. On the contrary, the land destroyed by the battle between the monsters was repaired at a speed visible to the naked eye. Even the Tianzhu Peaks that were trampled by Gu Yusheng were miraculously restored to their original state.
The sacred wooden ancient tripod is held up by nine Tianzhu peaks and stops firmly at a high altitude. The sacred aura is flowing around it. In the green light, there is the aura of crape myrtle gathered from the Taiyi world.
The legendary luck blessing of the human race really exists.
The monsters in the Ten Thousand Demon City could not get close to the divine cauldron, so they could only retreat in horror.
Zuo Wujian was hung on a Tianzhu Peak with a sword wire. He swayed slightly and reappeared above the sacred wooden ancient tripod. The five golden sword wires reunited on his five fingers, transforming into eight avatars. Nine sword shadows stood on the Tianzhu Peak. His fingers As soon as it was lifted up, a sword formation was formed at the same time. A huge green lotus rose from the ground and completely enveloped the entire City of Ten Thousand Demons. The nine green sword lotuses rotated layer by layer, superimposed and intertwined, forming a huge green lotus that covered the nine peaks.
"Nine Lotus Sword Techniques!"
Gu Yusheng looked at the sword lotuses that were bigger than the mountains. An unprecedented brilliance bloomed in his eyes. This sword technique is a sword technique that everyone can practice in Bai Yujing Sword Cultivator. He has seen several people perform it before. In his eyes, This sword technique was originally a derivative of the Qinglian Sword Technique, and was completely inferior to the mystery of the Qinglian Sword Technique. However, when a sword cultivator of the Fourteenth Realm of the World performed it, the subtlety of this sword technique was completely beyond his knowledge.
Each condensed sword lotus contains the supreme swordsmanship and is all-encompassing. Not only is Ten Thousand Monsters City enveloped, but the entire wilderness and even the swords of the entire Xuanjie are pulled by the sword lotus. The nine sword lotuses overlap and spin into one, rising from the ground like an exquisite sword tower. The exquisiteness of its skills is breathtaking.
The flowing light on the sword lotus transformed the meaning of the sword into reality. Zuo Wu Jianling stood on the green lotus. As the green lotus bloomed, eighteen lotus seeds bloomed from it. The lotus seeds were peeled off from the lotus pod and entered his body one by one.
Accompanied by the strange lotus sound, Gu Yusheng, who was unable to comprehend the sword intention, understood that the son of the sword lotus was opening up the hidden acupuncture points in Zuo Wujian's body in a strange way, and quickly opened up a meridian. This meridian was actually similar to the acupoint meridian he had opened recently.
boom!
Along with a powerful Qi source impact, Zuo Wujian's body showed a green halo, and all the sword intent was absorbed into his body. The huge green lotus held up the sacred wooden ancient tripod and soared upwards.
"Get up!"
Zuo Wujian appeared under the sacred wooden ancient cauldron, holding the divine cauldron with both hands. His clothes burst open, revealing his strong body. However, his body was not formed from martial arts practice in the traditional sense, but the sword and body technique formed by integrating swordsmanship into the body.
The eight clones are the same as the main body. The nine shadows raise their hands to support the cauldron at the same time. The green lotus rotates and makes a trilling sound.
"Uh...ah!"
Zuo Wujian's voice echoed throughout the world, and powerful explosive power was transmitted from his body to his palms, trying to lift the cauldron with his body.
Click!
A bolt of lightning tore through the sky, as if it was about to split the world into two. The sky that had just been clear was covered with dark clouds, like a doomsday scene. The world was shaking, the atmosphere of the world was chaotic, and countless monsters roared and roared wildly.
Dozens of spiritual ships in the sky were still useless with their barriers wide open. They were disturbed by unknown energy and fell to the earth.
Even a swordsman like Gu Yusheng cannot stay in the sky. He is like fallen leaves blown by the wind and floating on the ground. His feet are on the earth, like an earth dragon turning over and unable to stand firm.
Click.
Dense lightning tore through the sky, and the shadows of the world deep in the starry sky flickered. The ancient cauldron owned by Gu Yusheng also responded. Vaguely, Gu Yusheng felt that there were several mysterious qi machines connected to the ancient cauldron. They were scattered throughout Taiyi.The square world is vague.
